comparison: PCA-IV-AR(1) versus statically arbitrage-free SANOS decoder
data_qualification: GridMarketDefinition.load() first fits a smooth statically arbitrage-free SANOS surface to each date and evaluates it on the regular grid. This comparison tests the SANOS generative decoder against direct PCA when both use the same cleaned, SANOS-interpolated mid_vols observations; it does not test SANOS preprocessing against raw OptionMetrics interpolation.
dynamic_arbitrage_qualification: Static surface arbitrage and sampled fixed-contract return diagnostics are distinct. Failure to detect a one-sided opportunity in the sampled contracts does not prove absence of arbitrary dynamic arbitrage.
methodological_exclusion: No PCA path is penalized, rejected, projected, or reweighted by a static-arbitrage score. This is not Cont--Vuletic scenario reweighting.
